reading_list_candidate.title: Windows Agent Arena: Evaluating Multi-Modal OS Agents at Scale
reading_list_candidate.why: Co-authored by Cua's founder; the benchmark work the sandbox-and-eval thesis grew out of.

code_snippet.code:
import asyncio
from cua import Sandbox, Image, ComputerAgent

async def main():
    async with Sandbox.ephemeral(Image.linux()) as sb:
        agent = ComputerAgent(
            model="cua/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5",
            tools=[sb]
        )
        messages = [{"role": "user", "content": "Take a screenshot"}]
        async for result in agent.run(messages):
            print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
code_snippet.caption: One ComputerAgent loop over an ephemeral, swappable Sandbox, the same call whether the OS is Linux, macOS or Windows.
